people.name: Barzillai
people.line: A Gileadite who provided for David during Absalom's rebellion.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Barzillai said to the king, “How many are the days of the years of my life, that I should go up with the king to Jerusalem?
translations.bsb: But Barzillai replied, “How many years of my life remain, that I should go up to Jerusalem with the king?
translations.kjv: And Barzillai said unto the king, How long have I to live, that I should go up with the king unto Jerusalem?
translations.asv: And Barzillai said unto the king, How many are the days of the years of my life, that I should go up with the king unto Jerusalem?
